c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Require Photo ID for Voting
c.q: Constitutional amendment to require all voters not just those presenting to vote in person to present photo identification before voting.

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Maximum Income Tax Rate of 3.5%
c.q: Constitutional amendment to keep the State income tax rate from being raised higher than three and one-half percent (3.5%).

c.t: Constitutional Amendment - Property Tax Levy Limit
c.q: Constitutional amendment requiring limits on property tax increases by local governments.

c.t: Buncombe County Open Space Bonds Referendum
c.q: Additional property taxes may be levied on property located in the County of Buncombe in an amount sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on bonds if approved by the following ballot question.SHALL the order authorizing $30 million of bonds plus interest to provide funds to fund the acquisition and improvement of land or interests therein for conservation purposes including the protection of natural resources and preservation of farms and scenic landscapes and the development of parks greenways trails and other outdoor recreational opportunities and providing that additional taxes may be levied in an amount sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on the bonds be approved in light of the following:(1) The estimated cumulative cost over the life of the bonds using the highest interest rate charged for similar debt over the last 20 years would be $47615115 (consisting of $30 million principal amount of the bonds plus $17615115 of interest).(2) The estimated amount of property tax liability increase for each one hundred thousand dollars ($100000) of property tax value to service the cumulative cost over the life of the bond provided above would be $4.10 per year.

c.t: Buncombe County Housing Bonds Referendum
c.q: Additional property taxes may be levied on property located in the County of Buncombe in an amount sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on bonds if approved by the following ballot question.SHALL the order authorizing $40 million of bonds plus interest to provide funds to pay the capital costs of housing for the benefit of persons of low or moderate income including construction of related infrastructure improvements and acquisition of related land and rights-of-way and providing that additional taxes may be levied in an amount sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on the bonds be approved in light of the following:(1) The estimated cumulative cost over the life of the bonds using the highest interest rate charged for similar debt over the last 20 years would be $63486820 (consisting of $40 million principal amount of the bonds plus $23486820 of interest).(2) The estimated amount of property tax liability increase for each one hundred thousand dollars ($100000) of property tax value to service the cumulative cost over the life of the bond provided above would be $5.50 per year.
